claude delegate cancel.agent mcp: #37859: a stopped delegated task's result ends with the child run's stop notice ("Stopped by an agent: <reason>"); Rust's interrupt result does not carry the stop reason, so task_status's summary lacks it.

claude delegate live.items: #39528: the reference steers a delegated result into the parent's running Claude turn (sending it again as a new run if the turn ended first); Rust still queues it for Claude, since it cannot yet send an untaken steer again, so the notification lands outside that turn.
